## The claim

At least 80 percent of the 1,199 alleles the delivered callset never reported, which step 2's read-derived callers found and annotated, are confirmed at the same multiplicity by alignment-free k-mer genotyping.

**Prediction if true.** Of the 1,199 alleles in warehouse.it2_read_annotations that receive at least three usable probe pairs, at least 80 percent are called at the same genotype class the read callers assigned, at posterior >= 0.95.

**What would refute it.** Fewer than 80 percent are confirmed, in which case every biallelic count step 2 reported is revised downward and the read route gains a measured false-positive rate in place of a caveat.

## Weighing

```
prior 0.50  (log-odds +0.000)
  -1.800  refutes 0.90 — Of the 1,199 alleles the delivered callset never reported, the fully-probed ones are confirmed at the same multiplicity by k-mer genotype in only 27% to 43% per tier, against the 80% the claim named.   -> 0.142
  +1.400  supports 0.70 — The same instrument confirms 91% to 97% of the alleles the delivered callset did report, in the same genes and in the same run, so the low rate on the vendor-unreported set is a property of those alleles and not of the instrument.   -> 0.401
suggested confidence 0.40 (1 supporting, 1 refuting, 0 neutral)
```

The weighing is a transparent heuristic for triage, not a calibrated posterior: the strengths are human judgments, and rows drawn from the same underlying data are not independent the way the sum treats them.

**The committed confidence differs from the suggestion by -0.32.** The reasoning below is why.

| 2 | refuted | 0.08 | The claim named 80%. The measured confirmation of the 1,199 vendor-unreported alleles is 27-43% by tier — decisively below it. Lower than the heuristic's 0.40 for the same reason as H024: the supporting row is about the instrument, not the claim, and it is what makes the refutation *interpretable* rather than doubtful. The same run confirms 91-97% of the alleles the vendor did report, in the same genes, so the instrument works and roughly two thirds of the 1,199 are not corroborated. Pre-registered consequence stands: every step-2 biallelic count that rested on them is an upper bound, and the read route now has a measured false-positive rate instead of a caveat. |
